ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of WinRAR.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of WinRAR.exe.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WinRAR\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "mshta\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "regsvr32\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe")))
